name: Ground Turkey and Vegetable Stew
summary: A hearty stew with ground turkey, potatoes, white beans, and canned tomatoes. High protein and fills well.

ingredients.name: white beans or chickpeas, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the ground turkey. Break it up with a spoon and cook 6–8 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove and set aside.
In the same pot over medium heat, add the onion, carrots, and celery. Cook 5 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic, thyme, and paprika. Cook 1 minute.
Return the turkey to the pot. Add the potatoes, diced tomatoes, white beans, and chicken broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer covered for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Remove the lid and simmer another 5–10 minutes to thicken slightly.
Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve hot.

glutenFree.notes: All ingredients are naturally gluten-free. Verify that your chicken broth is gluten-free — most commercial broths are, but check labels on flavoured or seasoned varieties.

budgetNotes: Ground turkey is one of the higher-cost items on this site. Substitute with ground chicken or ground pork if cheaper.
Ground beef can replace turkey at lower cost, though the nutrition profile will shift (more fat, similar protein).
Freeze leftovers in portions. The stew reheats well with a splash of water or broth.
Add a can of corn or a cup of frozen peas in the last 5 minutes to stretch the recipe further.

pricingMetadata.notes: Ground turkey is the most expensive ingredient in this recipe. Priced at approximately $12.99/kg for lean ground turkey. Substitute with a cheaper protein to reduce total cost significantly.
